featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to extend my sincere thanks to Milin Vaidya and Sajavee Das from DMT Vacations for organizing a personalized tour of Dharamshala, Dalhousie, and Amritsar. Overall, the experience was outstanding, and their attention to our needs was highly professional.
​
Key Highlights:
​1. Logistics & Vehicle: The vehicle arranged for this trip was exceptional and far exceeded our expectations. Having such a reliable and high-quality vehicle was a significant advantage when navigating the hillside areas.
2. ​Customer Service (Sajavee Das): I must specifically commend Sajavee for her courtesy and responsiveness. She was incredibly accommodating with our last-minute requests, ensuring the driver took us to our requested locations without any hesitation.
​3. Accommodation Interiors: The hotels chosen generally had a great "look and feel," particularly Regenta Place, which featured impressive interior design.
​
Areas for Improvement:
​A. Dining Arrangements: A point of disappointment was the dinner service across all three hotels. Instead of a buffet, we were offered an à la carte menu, likely due to low occupancy. Unfortunately, the options were extremely limited and identical across all three properties. The hotel staff was also unwilling to customize or tweak the menu, which was a letdown.
​B. Food Quality: Specifically at Regenta Place, while the aesthetics were lovely, the food quality did not meet the high standards of the rest of the tour.
C. ​Driver/Guide Performance: While the driver was technically proficient and drove very safely throughout the journey, he did not provide the "guide" element we expected. He offered very little information or local tips regarding the landmarks we visited, which would have added more value to our sightseeing.
​

Conclusion:
Despite these specific points regarding the hotel dining and the driver’s lack of local insight, the overall management by DMT Vacations was excellent. Their ability to handle personalized requests made for a very smooth vacation. I would certainly recommend their services for a well-coordinated travel experience.
